messages.author: 5b7ff26c2b79d452
messages.subject: Strange behavoir of on-disk data
parts:
Hi Kylie,

I was checking out the capabilities of cardinal for lager-than-memory data. The Dataset was produced by a Bruker Rapiflex.
When I load my dataset and image the data, some pixels seem to not have any spectral information (See attached figures). 



> raw <- readImzML("171027_AD")
> raw_matter <- readImzML("dataset", attach.only = TRUE)
> image(raw, mz = 5025, main = "in memory")
> image(raw_matter, mz = 5025, main = "on-disk")



When I check the spectra for a region available in both cases they seem to be the same.

> plot(raw, coord = list(x = 650, y = 225), main = "in memory")
> plot(raw_matter, coord = list(x = 650, y = 225), main = "on-disk")



But when I check the spectra for a other region there seems to be no data for the "attach.only" dataset.

> plot(raw_matter, coord = list(x = 650, y = 300), main = "on-disk")
> plot(raw, coord = list(x = 650, y = 300), main = "in memory")



For me this seems to be a Bug or did I do something wrong? 
I'm using Cardinal 1.11.0 and matter 1.5.1 on R 3.4.2

Thank you in advance,
Thomas

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Strange behavoir of on-disk data
parts:
Hi Thomas

I'm having trouble replicating the problem on my end. Can you tell me the following things that would help?

- Why does raw use "171027_AD" but raw_matter uses "dataset" in readImzML()? What is the difference in these files?
- Did you try this dataset before the recent update, and did you experience the same problem then?
- What is the size the dataset? I assume it's 'continuous' imzML?
- The output of of sessionInfo()
- The output of dim(raw_matter)
- The output of tail(atomdata(iData(raw_matter)))

Thanks,
Kylie
